_aday.title: Life is Strange developer Don't Nod look primed for layoffs, as the studio announces a "transformation intitiative"
_aday.summary: It is unfortunately that time of day again (because this truly does seem to be a daily occurrence at this point). Back in June, things weren't looking so hot for Life is Strange studio Don't Nod, as it appeared that they'd be out of cash come this November . Now, it looks like the studio is preparing for layoffs. Read more

members.title: Life is Strange and Aphelion studio Don't Nod probably facing layoffs again, as it announces ominous-sounding "transformation initiative"
members.summary: French game developer and publisher Don't Nod - creator of the Life is Strange series and games like Remember Me , Vampyr , Banishers , Jusant and most recently Aphelion - seems as though it's about to enter another round of layoffs. Read more
